title: Halo header
description: A transparent top bar that lies on a black hero: big logo left, plain white links centred, a white pill-less button, a language square and (on phones) a three-line menu square on the right. The phone menu is a native disclosure panel.
notes: made for a dark backdrop: it switches itself to the dark tokens, so it needs a dark hero behind it
overlay by default: it lies on top of the next block
name: halodental-sonnet-header

props.name: links
props.description: the centred navigation (desktop) and the phone panel's list

props.name: cta
props.description: the white button on the right

props.name: language
props.description: the small square beside it, e.g. a language switch

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button

props.name: overlay
props.description: lie on top of the next block (a hero behind it) instead of pushing it down
